summary: SSE hardening (drop manual Connection: keep-alive, guard heartbeat task lifecycle + persist stream exceptions), rotating file log sink, dead-code removal of cancelled dolls-analogy feature.
final_report:
T64 done. All three changes landed against base aaf06ddeafa8c92584fa3bfe23c7ce122e8659a5; no commit per task spec.

1) SSE hardening (app/sse.py, 48->57): removed the manually set hop-by-hop 'Connection': 'keep-alive' header from sse_response — uvicorn owns connection framing, and the manually set Connection header is the prime suspect for the production RuntimeError('Response content longer than Content-Length') in httptools send during SSE: with the header forced on a streaming response the server/proxy framing assumptions no longer match what the app declares, so removing it lets uvicorn frame the stream itself. Cache-Control and X-Accel-Buffering untouched; ping behavior identical (': ping\n\n' every HEARTBEAT_SECONDS). heartbeat() hardened: the while loop is wrapped in try/except Exception (logger.exception('SSE stream failed') via module logger logging.getLogger('app'), then re-raise) so generator failures are logged once with full traceback and will persist to the new file log; try/finally guarantees next_task is cancelled+awaited on ANY exit path — StopAsyncIteration completion, provider exception, outer cancellation, and GeneratorExit from client disconnect/generator aclose() — with the await result swallowed BaseException-wide (matches the T40 _next_chunk cleanup precedent), eliminating the unguarded pending-task leak on early disconnect.

2) Persistent error logging (app/logging_setup.py, 46->78; app/main.py call site passes data_dir): setup_logging(secret: str = "", data_dir: Path | None = None). When data_dir is given it creates data_dir/logs/sage.log as a RotatingFileHandler(maxBytes=5_000_000, backupCount=3, encoding='utf-8') at INFO attached to the 'app' logger AND to logging.getLogger('uvicorn.error') at ERROR level, so uvicorn's own startup/runtime errors land in the same file. Console behavior and secret masking unchanged (RedactingFilter still applied to the app logger; smoke-verified the secret renders as *** in sage.log). A dedup guard reuses an existing same-path handler so repeated create_app calls (tests) cannot stack duplicate handlers or double-open the rotating file on Windows. Next time the SSE RuntimeError appears, its full traceback persists to <data_dir>/logs/sage.log instead of vanishing with the console.

3) Dead-code removal (app/llm/messages.py, 276->220; app/services/sessions/turn.py, 365->363): deleted the cancelled dolls-analogy feature — DOLLS_MARKERS, mentions_dolls_analogy, scrub_analogy_sentencewise, scrub_history_analogies plus their private plumbing (_ANALOGY_OMITTED_PREFIX, _SENTENCE_SPLIT_RE) and removed turn.py's two unused imports (mentions_dolls_analogy, scrub_analogy_sentencewise, lines 20-21). Word-bounded grep over app/tests/static confirms zero remaining references. Scope note recorded in notes: scrub_history_analogies was wired into messages.py's own _history_messages via allow_first_analogy plumbing that existed only for this cancelled feature, so removal necessarily touched that one call site and deleted the now-dead allow_first_analogy parameter from _history_messages/build_chat_messages; verified no caller (turn.py L148, structured_outputs.py L68, any test incl. test_outputs_security.py) ever passed it, so signatures are safe to shrink. Nothing else in either file was modified.

Verification: python -m compileall app clean (exit 0). pytest tests/test_api_chat_sse.py tests/test_tools_loop.py -q = 1 failed, 23 passed; the single failure is test_api_chat_sse.py::test_turn_rejects_missing_config (assert 400 got 404), which is exactly documented oc-issues #34 — environmental (.env defines BROT_API_KEY; pydantic-settings validation_alias makes the brot_api_key='' init kwarg lose to .env), reproduces at base without these changes, not caused by T64. Behavioral smoke checks passed: file sink created + secret masked + uvicorn.error wired at ERROR + no handler duplication on re-setup; heartbeat normal completion clean through finally (StopAsyncIteration swallowed); exception path logs 'SSE stream failed' with traceback then re-raises RuntimeError('boom'); aclose() disconnect path exits without leaked-task warnings.

Reconciliation: vs base_commit only my five declared files changed under me (diff --stat matches exactly my edits); concurrently dirty files app/api/sessions.py and app/services/sessions/session.py were already modified before start, are outside my set, and were left untouched. tests/test_api_chat_sse.py needed no change (it asserts content-type/cache-control only, never the removed Connection header). oc-issues #36 already records the rg-missing environment issue hit during reference grep; no duplicate appended. verification analyzer_pending: Merlin should rerun the two pytest files on the Pi/Linux runtime where .env is absent (expect 24 passed) and ideally exercise one live SSE stream to confirm no Content-Length RuntimeError after the header removal.
